name: SkiErg
instructions: Stand on the footplates holding the handles above your head.
Pull the handles down and back while hinging slightly at the hips.
Let the handles rise as you stand tall.
Set the damper to a comfortable level.
longevityNotes: Cardiovascular fitness is the single strongest predictor of a long, active life. Regular cardio work keeps the heart, lungs, and brain in shape for decades.
overview: A cardio machine that mimics the double-pole motion of skiing for full-body conditioning.
